beats.text: And I'm Mishu! Today is a big fun learning day!
Animals, shapes, vehicles, ocean friends, numbers, and the weather! Let's go!
Let's go to the farm and meet some baby animals!
It's a puppy! A puppy says woof, woof!
beats.label: Puppy

beats.text: It's a kitten! A kitten says meow!
beats.label: Kitten

beats.text: It's a duckling! A duckling says quack, quack!
beats.label: Duckling

beats.text: It's a little chick! A chick says cheep, cheep!
beats.label: Chick

beats.text: It's a lamb! A lamb says baa!
beats.label: Lamb

beats.text: It's a piglet! A piglet says oink, oink!
beats.label: Piglet

beats.text: It's a calf! A baby cow says moo!
beats.label: Calf

beats.text: It's a bunny! Bunnies go hop, hop, hop!
beats.label: Bunny

beats.text: It's a foal! A baby horse says neigh!
beats.label: Foal

beats.text: It's a lion cub! A lion says roar!
beats.label: Lion Cub

beats.text: Lion Cub! Can you say lion cub?
It's a baby elephant! It has a long trunk!
beats.label: Baby Elephant

beats.text: Baby Elephant! Can you say elephant?
It's a little monkey! Ooh, ooh, aah, aah!
beats.label: Monkey

beats.text: It's a circle! Round like a ball!
beats.label: Circle

beats.text: It's a square! It has four sides!
beats.label: Square

beats.text: It's a triangle! It has three sides!
beats.label: Triangle

beats.text: It's a heart! I love you!
beats.label: Heart

beats.text: It's a rectangle! Like a door!
beats.label: Rectangle

beats.text: It's an oval! Like an egg!
beats.label: Oval

beats.text: It's a diamond! Like a kite!
beats.label: Diamond

beats.text: Beep, beep! Let's see some vehicles!
The wheels go round and round!
It's a fire truck! Nee naw, nee naw!
beats.label: Fire Truck

beats.text: Fire Truck! Can you say fire truck?
It's a police car! Wee woo, wee woo!
beats.label: Police Car

beats.text: Police Car! Can you say police car?
It's an ambulance! It helps people!
beats.label: Ambulance

beats.text: It's an airplane! It flies in the sky!
beats.label: Airplane

beats.text: It's a boat! It floats on water!
beats.label: Boat

beats.text: It's a tractor! It works on the farm!
beats.label: Tractor

beats.text: Splash! Let's go to the ocean!
It's a little fish! Swim, swim!
beats.label: Fish

beats.text: It's an octopus! It has eight arms!
beats.label: Octopus

beats.text: It's a whale! A very big whale!
beats.label: Whale

beats.text: It's a turtle! Slow and steady!
beats.label: Turtle

beats.text: It's a starfish! A star in the sea!
beats.label: Starfish

beats.text: It's a dolphin! It loves to jump!
beats.label: Dolphin

beats.text: It's a jellyfish! Wiggly and wobbly!
beats.label: Jellyfish

beats.text: Now let's count with yummy fruits!
One, two, three, four! Four strawberries!
beats.label: Four

beats.text: One, two, three, four, five! Five lemons!
beats.label: Five

beats.text: One, two, three, four, five, six! Six cherries!
beats.label: Six

beats.text: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven! Seven pears!
beats.label: Seven

beats.text: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight! Eight kiwis!
beats.label: Eight

beats.text: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine! Nine pineapples!
beats.label: Nine

beats.text: One, two, three, four, five, six, seven, eight, nine, ten! Ten mangoes!
beats.label: Ten

beats.text: It's sunny! The sun is shining!
beats.label: Sunny

beats.text: Look at the sky! What's the weather?
Look at the sky! What's the weather?
It's a rainbow! So many colours!
beats.label: Rainbow

beats.text: Wow! We learned so many things today!
Which one was your favourite? Mine was the fire truck!
